about_the_game:
Forge Legends, Shape Kingdoms!

In Magic Forge Tycoon, every hammer strike shapes history. Manage your astral forge, craft enchanted weapons, and decide the fate of warring kingdoms. Will you fuel conflicts or forge peace through your creations? Master the economy, fulfill demanding contracts from rulers and nobles, and carve your name among the greatest blacksmiths!

Master the Art of Forging

  • Select the best weapon patterns, fine-tune every setting, and apply perfect enchantments for unmatched quality.

  • Find the perfect balance between style and durability to create exceptional weapons.

  • Increase productivity to optimize your output and craft masterpieces fit for kings.

Expand and Upgrade Your Workshop

  • Purchase new technologies to speed up production and refine your creations.

  • Upgrade your forge to unlock advanced crafting techniques and boost production capacity.

  • Invest in research to discover new weapon designs and exotic resources.

Control the Economy and Trade

  • Buy and sell materials in a dynamic market influenced by wars, alliances, and resource scarcity.

  • Stockpile raw materials, anticipate price fluctuations and kingdom conflicts to secure the best deals.

  • Manage resources wisely—poor investments or shortages can cost you dearly!

Influence Wars and Politics

  • Complete contracts for rival factions and watch your weapons reshape the balance of power.

  • Accumulate Favor Points to unlock better contracts, political perks, and exclusive forge bonuses.

  • Establish trade outposts in strategic regions to expand your influence and gather crucial intelligence.

A World That Evolves with Your Choices

  • Your economic choices can make a kingdom thrive… or bring about its downfall.

  • Wars, alliances, and economies shift dynamically, presenting new challenges every playthrough.

  • Every forged weapon leaves a mark on history. Will you be a peacemaker or a war profiteer?

Become the Realm’s Greatest Blacksmith!

Magic Forge Tycoon blends intuitive gameplay with deep management mechanics in a living, reactive world. Expand your forge, master the trade, and see how your creations shape the destiny of nations.

Demo features:

  • 5 of the 42 weapon patterns to unlock and experiment with.

  • Play up to 3 in-game years (out of 40 in the full game).

  • Upgrade your forge and tech to level 1 of 3.

  • Use sliders to find the sweet spot for high-quality weapons.

  • Random events to take advantage of when trading resources.

  • 4 races: humans, elves, greenskins, and dwarves.

  • A demo-exclusive leaderboard (the demo will remain live after launch).

  • Cloud Save

Add the game to your wishlist and forge your legacy in fire and steel!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-1115G4 or AMD Ryzen 3 5300U
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 710, 2GB (Legacy: NVIDIA GeForce GT 440), AMD R5 240, 2GB (Legacy: AMD Radeon HD 6670), Integrated: Intel UHD Graphics 620
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11300H or AMD Ryzen 5 5600H
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti, 4GB (Legacy : NVIDIA GeForce GTX 770, 2GB) ou AMD RX 570, 4GB (Legacy : AMD R9 280X, 3GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Craft enchanted weapons, experiment to improve quality, trade resources, and shape rival kingdoms’ destinies in this relaxed fantasy tycoon. Fulfill contracts, upgrade your forge, and choose whether to keep peace or stoke war to become Korendor’s most renowned blacksmith.
